name: Mangalore Buns
instructions: 1. Mash the bananas thoroughly until smooth. 2. Add sugar, salt, yogurt, and cumin seeds to the mashed bananas and mix well. 3. Incorporate the flour and baking soda, kneading into a soft, non-sticky dough. 4. Cover the dough and let it rest for at least 6-8 hours or overnight to ferment. 5. Divide the dough into lemon-sized balls and roll them into thick discs. 6. Heat oil in a pan and deep-fry the discs until they puff up and turn golden brown on both sides.
description: Mangalore Buns are a popular breakfast delicacy from the Udupi-Mangalore region of coastal Karnataka. These sweet, fluffy, deep-fried bread discs are traditionally served with spicy coconut chutney and a hot cup of coffee, creating a perfect balance of sweet and savory flavors.
